title: Most people open Claude Code, type a prompt, and treat it like a fancier ChatGPT
description:
Most people open Claude Code, type a prompt, and treat it like a fancier ChatGPT.

The 10x devs treat the folder like a system. A real CLAUDE.md that tells it how you build. Structure it knows by heart. The same setup Boris Cherny, the guy who made Claude Code, posts about.

Three paid apps later, this is the .claude folder setup I trust.

Comment “VIDEO” and I’ll send the full breakdown your way 🔥
